content:
tvOS 27 is the latest software update for Apple TV 4K and is now rolling out to all users. Here's what's new in tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 brings a completely revamped Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, customizable text sizes, and more

tvOS 27 can now be installed via the Settings app on Apple TV. The update is compatible with all Apple TV 4K models except the first generation; Apple TV HD is not supported.

Apple's new tvOS 27 update introduces the following features and changes:

Podcasts: Apple Podcasts gets a major revamp on tvOS, following the earlier iOS update this year. The new tvOS Podcasts app fully supports Apple's new video features, making it a great place to watch video podcasts. There's also a fresh new design with the addition of a sidebar navigation and more.

Update via iPhone: A convenient change in tvOS 27 is that you can now update your Apple TV 4K's software directly from your iPhone. Using the Home app in iOS 27, you can install tvOS 27 and future updates without ever needing to turn on the Apple TV.

Apple Music upgrades: Apple Music on tvOS 27 gains two new features. AutoMix arrives on Apple TV as a new option for song transitions, creating a DJ-like mix that's perfect for parties. Hi-Res Lossless Audio is another addition for users with compatible external speaker outputs.

Larger text size: You can now customize the system-wide text size using the Dynamic Type feature in the Settings app, allowing you to make text larger to suit your needs and viewing environment.

Finally, Apple says tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connections, smoother animations and app launch speeds, and makes Control Center more responsive.

What's missing: Siri AI and smart downloads

tvOS 27 notably lacks the new Siri AI assistant, with only the older version of Siri available. Rumors suggest this is because the upcoming new Apple TV 4K will have hardware upgrades capable of running Siri AI.

Another missing upgrade is the "smart downloads" feature Apple mentioned at WWDC. tvOS has never previously supported downloads for TV content, so the announcement came as a surprise. It's possible that "smart downloads" actually refers to certain system-related features unrelated to shows and movies. Either way, there's no sign of this feature anywhere in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27 yet? How's it working out for you? Let us know in the comments.
